answer: Make every grader post a bond shaped like a mesa: a flat floor it must lock before it may seal, which grows only through epochs of jury-matched work. A sybil farm must raise a separate mesa for each fake identity, so cost climbs linearly with n while each clone's vote stays capped. The check runs in a small kernel the ledger replays, and a seal that contradicts the verdict burns part of the bond. Clones become a tundra: costly to settle, slow to yield.
